recommendation: Keep the commit. The core resource definition now lives in HL7/admin-incubator, but this active core ModelInfo Library surface needed to match the applied FHIR-31569 semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-31569 was a Published/Persuasive PA change request for R5 asking to rationalize ChargeItemDefinition.applicability by replacing duplicated expression metadata fields with the Expression data type; its Jira resolution says the change was incorporated into FHIR-31521.
initial_application: FHIR-31521 commit 082ba11f51 applied the combined R5 ChargeItemDefinition source change by introducing applicability.condition of type Expression in source/chargeitemdefinition/structuredefinition-ChargeItemDefinition.xml and updating examples.
additional_context: FHIR-31521 kept applicability as a backbone so it could also carry effectivePeriod and relatedArtifact. ChargeItemDefinition was later removed from active core resource inputs by 71567db3ee and moved to HL7/admin-incubator, where the current source and CI JSON already have applicability.condition as Expression. The active core Library/FHIR-ModelInfo source still exposed the old applicability string children.
reconciliation: Changed source/library/library-fhir-model-definition-content.xml so ChargeItemDefinition.Applicability has condition with elementType FHIR.Expression, removing the stale description/language/expression string children.
source_changes: source/library/library-fhir-model-definition-content.xml: replaced ChargeItemDefinition.Applicability.description/language/expression string children with condition as FHIR.Expression.
